g.text: Cylinder accuracy: controlled changes and saved FEM configurations
All panels use saved plane-wave cylinder errors; lower is better. h is a FEM mesh-construction label; n is interface polygon resolution.
The fitted-cylinder job stopped after saved successes. Missing later cases are omitted; double averaging retains its worse observed errors.
Square markers labeled volume are saved circle controls; earlier FEM entries use FE-point extraction. These are measured configurations, with no fitted convergence law.
